add-subtract-1000-skill-01.target: I can add three-digit numbers with base-ten blocks or drawings by adding hundreds, tens, and ones.
add-subtract-1000-skill-01.ifCorrect: You can do this: can add three-digit numbers with base-ten blocks or drawings by adding hundreds, tens, and ones.
add-subtract-1000-skill-01.ifMissed: Practice this skill again. Watch for this mistake: Adding hundreds to tens or ones (300 + 40 + 5 read as 300 + 4 + 5). Try this: Sort the blocks by place before combining and record each place total.

add-subtract-1000-skill-02.skill: Adding with New Tens and Hundreds
add-subtract-1000-skill-02.target: I can add within 1,000 when I need to make a new ten or a new hundred and relate it to a written method.
add-subtract-1000-skill-02.ifCorrect: You can do this: can add within 1,000 when I need to make a new ten or a new hundred and relate it to a written method.
add-subtract-1000-skill-02.ifMissed: Practice this skill again. Watch for this mistake: Writing a two-digit place total in one place (ones add to 13, so 13 is written in the ones place). Try this: Trade ten ones for a ten and ten tens for a hundred on the mat; record the trade in the written method.

add-subtract-1000-skill-03.target: I can subtract three-digit numbers with base-ten blocks or drawings, or by counting up.
add-subtract-1000-skill-03.ifCorrect: You can do this: can subtract three-digit numbers with base-ten blocks or drawings, or by counting up.
add-subtract-1000-skill-03.ifMissed: Practice this skill again. Watch for this mistake: Subtracting in the wrong order in a place (smaller minus larger digit). Try this: Model the first number only, then take away; or count up from the smaller number on an open number line.

add-subtract-1000-skill-04.target: I can subtract within 1,000 when I need to break apart a ten or a hundred, including across zeros.
add-subtract-1000-skill-04.ifCorrect: You can do this: can subtract within 1,000 when I need to break apart a ten or a hundred, including across zeros.
add-subtract-1000-skill-04.ifMissed: Practice this skill again. Watch for this mistake: Not regrouping across a zero (500 − 123 → 423) or forgetting to reduce the hundred after trading. Try this: Show 500 as 4 hundreds, 9 tens, 10 ones with blocks before subtracting.
